unit: A source-supported AI workflow in a particular deploying organization; different functions can share a source and leakage group
inclusion: Specific real problem, task and context
Reported operational use with provenance, rather than merely a proposed generic technology
No duplicate deploying-organization/workflow observation in the curated cohort
scope: Public, enterprise, personal, education and nonprofit domains are all eligible; scope alone never deletes raw data
outcome_rule: A numeric effect is not required. Supplier/agency reports, qualitative operation, anticipated effects and independently measured effects must stay distinct. None becomes independently measured through schema or URL checks.

factor.unknown_rule: ABSTAIN, never imputed as no factor

strategy.unknown_rule: ABSTAIN, never fabricated from a benefit number or generic tool name

dispositions.EXPERIMENT_SUITABLE_AI_SILVER: Curated source-supported workflow with completed independent annotation and explicit conflict resolution
dispositions.REFERENCE_ONLY: Useful background/source evidence; no promotion to a validated individual workflow
dispositions.EXCLUDE: Analytic exclusion with evidence reason, such as parser artifact or duplicate; original remains preserved

splits: Existing 10 questions remain Dev. New 12 synthetic questions were authored after protocol hash freeze. Shared IR case corpus is not an unseen-organization Test. Group folds are auxiliary training validation only.
label_scope: AI-Silver; human Gold count zero. Researcher signoff is not fabricated. Human signoff was an earlier conservative reporting gate, not a repository requirement for preparing AI-Silver experiment inputs.
not_claimed: Individual factual verification of all 11766 registry records
